svg.title: Where new foam is born
svg.desc: One exaggerated wave and, under it, the four quantities FoamBlit computes along it: the grid determinant, the compression mask, the leading-edge mask and their product, which is non-zero just around and ahead of the crest.

g.text: Wave (Q·k·A = 0.8, exaggerated), green = where new foam is added
det = Tx·Bz − Tz·Bx: how squeezed the grid is (1 = flat)
leading = saturate(slope · −D + 0.5): favours the front face
ridge = compression × leading (× scrolling noise, not shown)
Graphs use rest position x, which is what the foam texture is indexed by; the profile above is displaced.
